g.text: In the Authorization Code flow, the user logs in directly at the Authorization Server,
so neither a Pre-Authorized Code nor a tx_code is generated.
A Credential Offer for the Authorization Code flow
is not stored and can be retrieved again.
issuer_state (value from the Credential Offer, not validated currently)
The redirect_uri must be the same as the Redirect URI
of the Client registered with the Authorization Server.
Proof verification, Status List index allocation, Credential generation and
response encryption are the same as in P230-6 Request Credential.
User Claims are retrieved using the sub (logged-in user) of the access_token.
